messages:
maya: Heads up — promote pipeline is failing on staging. deploy-bot posted an artifact metadata mismatch during publish.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] publish failed for image redwood/runner:rc3 - manifest digest mismatch on registry (expected sha256:aaa111..., got sha256:bbb222...).

devon: Ugh, seen this after a partial multipart upload. Could be proxy reupload race. @samir any logs to confirm?

samir: looking now. cache index shows upload marked complete but registry verify failed. I can see two overlapping PUTs around the same object key — likely concurrent reupload left stale metadata. Pulling signed URL timelines.

lina: What's the customer impact? Is the canary blocked? :eyes: 

maya: Canary promotion is blocked; release window in ~30m. Options: rollback to rc2, retry publish on same tag (risk same race), or reupload under a new tag and repromote.

devon: Rollback quickest but we'd lose rc3 fixes. rc2 had a green smoke about 2h ago — safe fallback.

samir: I can do a forced reupload with strict verify and TTL bump to avoid the race, but doing the same tag may still hit the race if another process retries. Prefer reupload to a fresh tag (rc3-hotfix1) and update metadata atomically. That should be <15m.

lina: Also recommend we add a short-term cache-ttl increase on the registry index to avoid immediate reupload collisions. Can infra flip that?

maya: Decision call: reupload to new tag rc3-hotfix1 + pause auto-promote. If that fails we rollback to rc2. @oncall-bot please pause auto-promote for this window.

oncall-bot: Auto-promote paused for release-window-2026-03-22 by maya.

deploy-bot: manual publish started for redwood/runner:rc3-hotfix1 -> upload initiated.

devon: Noted — fallback plan is rollback to rc2 (devon owning rollback).

samir: Upload finished, manifest verified OK, registry returned expected digest. Kicking canary promote in 2m.

maya: Canary promote succeeded; smoke tests green. No regressions seen. Planning prod promote in 10m unless someone objects.

lina: No objections. Release notes updated: added note about artifact metadata race and that we used rc3-hotfix1. Link: https://git.redwood/release/notes/rc3-hotfix1

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll file a short postmortem and follow-up with infra for a longer-term fix (serialization on artifact uploads + cache-ttl guard). Assigning to release owner for final steps.
